title: Cashball Puffer Vest
body_html:
Cashball is an innovative fill that leverages the unique properties of cashmere in an eco- and animal-friendly way. Made primarily of pre-consumer waste, it’s cruelty-free (since cashmere is humanely harvested, unlike some live-plucked waterfowl downs), environmentally friendly (since it makes use of the excess left behind in the cashmere refining process), and offers the lightweight, compressible, breathable warmth cashmere is famous for. It’s effective even when wet, draws moisture away from the body, and keeps its shape.

A soft, creamy styling paste that delivers light, flexible hold with a clean matte finish, Hold Fast is designed for control without stiffness. It spreads easily, works cleanly through the hair, and sets with natural texture and grip so hair looks considered, not overly styled.

  • Light hold with movement
  • Texture without dryness
  • Control without shine

 

How to Use: 

Scoop a small amount and work between palms. Build gradually. A little goes a long way.

  • Apply to towel-dried hair and let air dry for a natural look and soft texture
  • Apply to dry hair for added texture and separation
  • Apply to towel-dried hair and blow-dry for extra control and volume

Our Shetland Wool collection begins once more at a family owned, eighteenth-century mill nestled in the far north of Scotland’s Aberdeenshire. There, generations of skilled workers have spun yarn widely admired, even envied for its unlikely balance of softness and durability, and a lightweight feel that yields easy, disproportionate warmth. But this year we’re trying something new and a bit unorthodox with our most extensive Shetland offerings yet. So alongside the sturdy grays and simple stripes that make a staple, you’ll encounter a shock of garden leaf green, vibrant and dominant patterns, and silhouettes drawn from unlikely sources. And it’s all been brushed twice to tease out the wool’s natural fibers, soft against your and any other skin that might feel it.

title: What The World Needs Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by Josh Peterson for Trimcraft Surfboards. Haley Pin. 7'4" x 21 3/8" x 2 3/4", 2+1 fin, pin tail, PU- constructed surfboard. Features a triplane bottom shape with a vee under the nose – into double concave, spiral vee, then a flat spot behind the fin. Suited for waves knee-high to overhead.

title: Little Faith Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by John Simon for Trimcraft. Haley Pin. 7'2" x 21 1/8" x 2 3/4", 2+1 fin, pin tail, PU- constructed surfboard. Features a triplane bottom shape with a vee under the nose – into double concave, spiral vee, then a flat spot behind the fin. Suited for waves knee-high to overhead.

title: Plaid Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by Josh Peterson for Trimcraft Surfboards. 6'3" x 20 3/8" x 2 1/2", 2+1 fin, round tail, PU-constructed surfboard. Features a V to double concave through the nose, middle, and tail of the board with a V out the tail. The board features a low entry rocker and medium tail rocker with a fuller rail line. Suited for waves waist - overhead.

title: Shipswheel Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by Josh Peterson of Peterson Surfboards. Fiend. 6'0" x 19 1/2" x 2 1/2", quad fin, rounded pin tail, PU- constructed surfboard. Features a single concave running nose to tail with V out the tail. The boards features a modern rocker and rail line. Suited for waves chest high - overhead.

title: Osprey Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by Andrew Zinicola of Storyteller Surfboards. Asymmetric shape available for regular & goofy foot surfers. 6'1" x 19 1/4" x 2 3/8", twin fin, asymmetrical tail, PU- constructed surfboard. Features an elongated rail line on the toe side and a softer more curved rail line on the heel side. The bottom has a triplane with a single concave running nose to tail with V out the tail. Suited for waves knee - overhead.

title: Rainbow Logo Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by Andrew Zinicola of Storyteller Surfboards. Terrapin model. 5'10" x 20 1/2" x 2 1/2", 2 +1 fin configuration, flex tail,  PU foam & epoxy glassing surfboard. Inspired by the stubbies built by Australian board builders in the 1970's, the boards feature a triplane bottom with a chine edge. The bottom contours are a single concave under the front foot into a double concave and spiral V out the tail, they also have a concave deck. Suited for waves knee - well overhead.

title: Vayu Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by Jordan Brazie. 5'10" x 19.50" x 2.385", twin-fin winged swallow tail, PU-constructed surfboard. Features an entry V under nose to a single concave, into double concave to V out the tail. Suited for waves knee-height to overhead.

title: Cry for the New World Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by Jordan Brazie. 5'10" x 20.75" x 2.525", twin fin fish, PU-constructed surfboard. Features V in the nose, into a single concave, into a double concave to V out the tail. Suited for waves knee-height to overhead.

title: Ghost Nets Suck Surfboard
body_html: Hand-shaped in the USA by John Simon for Trimcraft. Symmetrical Snake. 6'0" x 19 5/8" x 2 3/8", quad fin, round tail, PU-constructed surfboard. Features a deep single concave that runs from the nose through the tail of the board and a modern shortboard rail line & rocker. Suited for waves chest to overhead.
